text:
lee: Heads-up: scheduling a dawn maintenance (04:00-06:00 UTC) for apac-east1 to do PCIe link retrain + NIC microcode update. We'll do rolling reboots by rack. Purpose: reduce sporadic pcie-link flaps we've seen on some A100 hosts.

nadia: rough capacity impact? any high-QPS tenants that need early notice?

lee: expect a 6-9% usable-GPU capacity dip during the window; affected pools: nebula and apollo (apac-east1). we've flagged top-5 enterprise tenants in the runbook.

omar: propose doing two quick canaries on disjoint ToR switches, then run 15m mini-batches instead of full rack drains to keep kvcache warm.

lee: agree. canaries: rack-3 and rack-11. mini-batch flow: cordon -> evict noncritical -> soft-reboot -> verify health -> kvseed -> resume. targeted 8-12min per mini-batch.

infra-bot: maintenance ticket created: #3421 (dawn-pcie-nic-update). Reminder scheduled 90m prior.

finops: cost flag: if we route heavy traffic to us-west for fallbacks, what's our egress exposure?

omar: current apac-east1 outbound ~600GB/h for model-serving. If we shift 3h peak to us-west, at $0.11/GB -> 600GB * 3 * 0.11 = ~$198. Add ~10% headroom for retries = ~$218.

nadia: also watch for transient billing from double-serving during failover. set a short TTL on cross-region DNS to avoid long tails.

lee: runbook excerpt below (short):
```
03:40 UTC - preflight: health checks, reserved slots(10%), notify oncall
04:00 - canary rack-3: cordon + drain noncritical, soft-reboot, smoke test
04:12 - kvseed rack-3, monitor p99 tail & mem pressure 5m
04:20 - canary rack-11 repeat
04:35 - mini-batches across racks (8-12m per batch)
05:50 - final sweep, uncordon, postflight telemetry collection
```

omar: smoke tests: perf probe for embeddings (latency, errors), sample generation, and kv hit ratio. I'll post result snapshots here.

lee: autoscale tweak: set cluster-autoscaler max-surge +7% and temporarily raise scale-up aggressiveness to reduce client throttling during soft-evac.

finops: can you capture an egress delta estimate in the runbook? put a conservative $300 cap and I'll approve the spend if we stay below.

nadia: network note: switch firmware on rack-11 was hotpatched last week, but rack-3 still on older firmware. that's why we picked both. if we see asymmetric failure, abort and isolate switch.

omar: failure criteria: smoke test p99 > baseline*1.5 OR >2% error rate OR tcp retrans > threshold. If triggered -> abort and rollback.

lee: rollback steps: uncordon rack, reinstate traffic weights, trigger emergency kvseed to reduce cold-hit, and if necessary, roll back NIC microcode via the provider image. Page infra lead + oncall.

infra-bot: 30m pre-maint reminder posted to oncall channel and tenant-notify scheduled for flagged customers.

finops: small ops ask - label all cross-region traffic from this maintenance with "maintenance=3421" so we can reconcile cost easily.

lee: done. adding label + tagging in telemetry. runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/apac/pcienic-3421 (short checklist).

nadia: I'll coordinate tenant notices and put a site banner for apac-east1.

omar: posting a quick smoke-test script here for visibility:
```bash
# quick perf probe
for m in embeddings gen; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/model/$m -d '{"prompt":"health-check"}' | jq '.latency'; done
```

lee: thanks. will open calendar invite and assign owners. ping here if anything else stands out :rocket:
